status: exploratory follow-up; Nb3/A10 outcomes already exposed; saved before new fits
hypothesis: Epithelial identity adds descriptive information about recipient chemokine RNA beyond amount-related proxies.
population: one-to-one intersection of paired species QC, fixed panel scores and complete nonnegative day7/day14 imaging; positive species read totals; exclude TIGIT and TDTOMATO from all train/test sets
plate_handling: target holdouts include training-derived plate indicator columns; whole-plate holdouts omit plate indicators
model: weighted OLS with intercept; each training target has total weight one; training-only feature standardization; drop training-constant columns; abort rank-deficient designs; no tuning
panel_overlap: match source mouse gene names case-insensitively to inherited AT2 panel; exclude entire target groups in declared sensitivity

evaluation.target_holdout: 5 target groups; stable SHA256(target) lexical order assigned round-robin; all wells of a target stay together
evaluation.plate_shift: leave one whole plate out; also purge its targets from training even if present on other plates
metrics: per-target error changes and every fold
evaluation.minimum: each fold >=20 training targets and >=5 test targets; all four plates present for target holdouts

reference_handling: No outcome centering and no shared-control contrasts. No test outcome used to fit transformations. Inherited whole-screen TMM scores remain fixed, so upstream normalization exposes held-out count distributions; this is a retrospective diagnostic conditional on that normalization, not clean prospective validation.
decision: Report continuous error changes and fold signs; no arbitrary biological utility threshold. Broad identity generalization needs consistency across target/plate diagnostics and exclusions; inconsistency narrows only this operational predictor.
limits: technical wells and perturbation targets are not independent preparations
post-treatment adjustment cannot identify causal mediation
imaging and RNA are amount-related proxies, not viable cell counts
no recipient state, protein or function measurements
